build_binary_local_branching_mip: build a MIP model with binary local branching constraints from an incumbent solution and neighbourhood size
build_general_local_branching_mip: build a MIP model with general local branching constraints including auxiliary variables for non-binary integer variables
run_lns_lp_solution: run LP relaxation of a local branching MIP to find an improved solution within the neighbourhood
run_improve_solution: run a MIP solver on a local branching model to improve an incumbent solution with SCIP parameters
review_get_binary_local_branching_mip: review the binary local branching function that adds invalid cuts to restrict search near an incumbent
